test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To be in hot water

options.text: To be in a difficult situation in which you can be criticised
To enjoy hot baths as a part of a health treatment
To enjoy being praised for taking up a challenge
To be bold and refuse to be bullied by your superior

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. “****To be in a difficult situation in which you can be criticised.”**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase:

__
 
• The phrase **‘t****o be in hot water****’**** **means to get into a troubled or dangerous situation.
 
• Example: *​The man found himself **in hot water** for revealing some secret news.*
 
• Hence, **the only possible answer is option 1 ‘**To be in a difficult situation in which you can be criticised**’**, which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

**Correct meaning:**__ *To be in a difficult situation in which you can be criticised.*
